parts:
Hi all,

Sorry this is a very basic question but I cant construct a marker file using the code: 

> >B cell
Error: unexpected '>' in ">"
> expressed: cd19
Error: object 'expressed' not found
> not expressed: CD3
Error: unexpected symbol in "not expressed"

I have successfully installed monocle, garnett and the other required packages. Any help most appreciated!

Tom

messages.subject: Re: problem with marker file creation
parts:
Hi Tom,

Looks to me like you're inputing the marker info into the command line. You need to put all your marker into a marker file and then you'll pass the path to where it's saved into the downstream functions. Try running the examples on the website 

Best,
Hannah
